label.description: Human-readable profile name shown in DWARF.

node_type.description: Implementation mix provisioned by this profile.

x-ui-option-descriptions.mixed: Provision interoperating cardano-node and Amaru processes.

network_magic.description: Cardano network discriminator shared by every node in the profile.

peer_sharing.description: Whether nodes advertise and consume peer-sharing information.

remote_runtime_root.description: Absolute deployment directory used for this profile on the runtime host.

compose_project.description: Docker Compose project name used to isolate this profile's containers and network.

topology_pattern.description: Topology generator used to connect the provisioned nodes.

x-ui-option-descriptions.local-mesh: Connect locally provisioned nodes as a peer mesh.

shared_genesis.description: Whether all implementations start from the same generated genesis and network parameters.

amaru_network.description: Named public-network configuration supplied to Amaru.

x-ui-option-descriptions.preview: Use Cardano's Preview test network configuration.
x-ui-option-descriptions.preprod: Use Cardano's Pre-production test network configuration.
x-ui-option-descriptions.mainnet: Use Cardano mainnet configuration; treat operations as production-sensitive.

upstream_peer_address.description: Host and port of an external upstream peer used by attached or relay profiles.

listen_address.description: Address on which the generated node service listens for peer traffic.

config_source_dir.description: Directory containing source node configuration and genesis material.

public_network.description: Named Cardano public network used as the profile's configuration source.

x-ui-option-descriptions.mainnet: Use Cardano mainnet; treat operations as production-sensitive.

testbed.description: Optional testbed selector forwarded to deployment-specific profile tooling.

version_policy.description: How DWARF resolves real node releases before deployment. Omitted or blank values use latest-confirmed as a recorded safe implicit default; they never select an ambient node binary or mutable image.

x-ui-option-descriptions.latest-confirmed: Use the catalog default that passed the complete runtime contract for this deployment type.
x-ui-option-descriptions.latest-stable: Use the newest stable release; an unqualified selection requires explicit acknowledgement.
x-ui-option-descriptions.exact: Pin an exact implementation release or mixed compatibility pair.

cardano_version.description: Exact Cardano-node release used when version_policy is exact. Mixed profiles may instead select compatibility_pair.

amaru_version.description: Exact Amaru release used when version_policy is exact. Mixed profiles may instead select compatibility_pair.

compatibility_pair.description: Catalog id for an exact Cardano-node and Amaru pair whose mixed-topology status and evidence are tracked together.
